name: Zero-Downtime Database Migration with Phased Rollback

# Zero-Downtime PostgreSQL Column Migration: Expand-and-Contract Pattern

## Architecture Overview

```
┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│                    MIGRATION PHASES                              │
│

invariantResults.text: Prohibits single-statement table-wide UPDATE due to table bloat, lock contention, and transaction replication lag

Uses phased expand-and-contract: 1) add nullable columns; 2) dual-write (trigger or app code); 3) batch backfill with bounded chunk sizes (e.g. 1000-5000 rows by primary key); 4) enforce NOT NULL constraint via CHECK ... NOT VALID followed by VALIDATE CONSTRAINT; 5) switch reads; 6) remove dual-write; 7) drop old column
Defines explicit non-destructive rollback path at every phase
Identifies AccessExclusiveLock required for ALTER TABLE DROP COLUMN and schedules during low traffic or with low lock_timeout

trapResults.text: Adding NOT NULL column without default in older Postgres or locking table
Dropping old column before all application replicas are running new code
